note: Peak resident memory (MB) of the process of each kind of layer of F2a/F2b on BRA, the largest country, measured in the cold round of 2026-11-03 (interim/BRA/*/layers.json; COMMANDS 88/89; docs/_audit/memory_budget_88.md). The guard waits for peak_rss_mb + margin of free memory before a layer starts. F3 (land_eligibility) is not a layer process: it runs by stripes of rows since COMMAND 91 and peaks at 1,438 MB on BRA (see f3_phase).
